name: Compare human-readable records with another animal’s sensory access

uses.action: Keep the two daylight crops with the same yellow return. Fit the ultraviolet pane and count different low-return areas. Elian’s ink key and the two timed landing watches keep the detector pattern separate from an animal’s experience and its actions.

name: Use names, ordered grades, elapsed differences and count ratios in their proper roles

uses.action: Fit four physical rollers, run both faces and watch what survives. A name selects a puppet, the grades guide its rise, the clock retains a sixty-minute interval, and the single-square and pair counters retain the same ratio.

name: Distinguish better predictions from a larger artistic repertoire

uses.action: Pin a prediction for each unopened watch or leave it blank. Check where a bee first landed at noon and dusk, then invent a stage response that can succeed even when the landing overturned the prediction. The ribbon and choreography have separate records.
